steps.caption: Open the Quillstone Labs expansion signal from Signals.
Section 3 shows one source FOR the expansion.
Back on Signals, paste a later report that contradicts it.
Find signals. The message says the text was attached as counter-evidence to the open signal.
Open the Quillstone Labs expansion signal again.
Section 3 now has the report under AGAINST.
You can also add evidence by hand: what the source says, its name and link, then Add supporting or Add counter-evidence.
